caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of a Whisper model, comparing performance across different model sizes and training epochs. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6, utilizing a linear scale with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” ranges from approximately 35 to 68, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The first line, colored black and represented by a solid line, corresponds to the “tiny AdaLoRA_int” model, which begins at a WER of approximately 46 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 41 at epoch 6. The second line, colored dark gray and represented by a dashed line, represents the “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” model, beginning at a WER of approximately 51 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 37 at epoch 6. The third line, colored light gray and represented by a dashed line, represents the “tiny int4” model, which starts at a WER of approximately 53 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 40 at epoch 6. The fourth line, colored light blue and represented by a dashed line, corresponds to the “tiny int8” model, beginning at a WER of approximately 58 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 35 at epoch 6.  Finally, the fifth line, colored light green and represented by a dotted line, represents the “tiny full” model, which commences at a WER of approximately 63 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 58 at epoch 6.
